name: Tiny Rebel
description: Wales' biggest independent brewery, grown from a single taproom in Newport into one of the UK's best known craft names. Tiny Rebel made its name with bold, colourful cans and a Welsh red ale that took the top prize at the Great British Beer Festival.

beers.name: Cwtch
beers.description: A malt forward red ale with a citrus hop finish. Named Champion Beer of Britain in 2015, it remains the brewery's signature pour.

beers.name: Tropical
beers.description: A juicy, fruit driven pale ale built around punchy modern hop varieties, and one of the bigger selling craft cans in the UK.

beers.name: Dirty Stop Out
beers.description: A smooth, coffee accented milk stout with a rounded, dessert like sweetness.

name: Brains
description: Cardiff's oldest brewing name, founded in the Victorian era and still tied closely to the city's pubs and rugby culture. Brains produces a traditional core range alongside collaborations with other Welsh breweries.

beers.name: SA Best
beers.description: The brewery's long running best bitter, malty and balanced, long associated with pubs across South Wales.

beers.name: Rev James
beers.description: A smooth amber ale with a gentle caramel sweetness, one of the most widely poured cask ales in Wales.

name: Crafty Devil Brewing Co
description: Started in a garden shed in west Cardiff by two friends, Crafty Devil has grown into a Canton based brewery with its own taprooms in Cardiff and Penarth. The focus is on approachable, hop led beers made in small batches.

beers.name: Mikey Rayer
beers.description: The brewery's everyday pale ale, crisp and easy drinking, built as an all day session beer.

beers.name: Cardiff
beers.description: A clean, crisp lager brewed as the brewery's take on a classic session lager, popular in the taprooms.

name: Dark Element Brew Co
description: A newer arrival built on a decade of commercial brewing experience behind the scenes, Dark Element has quickly become one of the highest rated breweries in Wales by focusing tightly on hazy, hop forward pales and IPAs.

beers.name: Headlights
beers.description: A hazy pale ale showcasing modern hop varieties for a soft, juicy character.

beers.name: Urban Pale
beers.description: A lighter, everyday hazy pale designed for drinkability without losing hop character.

beers.name: Berserker
beers.description: A bolder, higher strength IPA built for drinkers wanting more intensity from the hop bill.

name: Untapped Brewing Company
description: Founded by two friends who began by borrowing other breweries' equipment, Untapped now brews from its own site near Raglan Castle in Monmouthshire, producing both traditional cask ales and more modern hoppy styles.

beers.name: Whoosh
beers.description: A hop forward, pale coloured session ale built for a bright, punchy aroma.

beers.name: Sundown
beers.description: A traditional golden ale in the classic cask mould, light and refreshing.

name: Felinfoel Brewery
description: The oldest working brewery in Wales, founded in the tinplate town of Llanelli. In 1935 Felinfoel became one of the first breweries in the world to sell beer in cans, and its flagship ale is still widely regarded as Wales' national beer.

beers.name: Double Dragon
beers.description: A rich, malt driven premium ale that the brewery has produced for generations, often described as the national ale of Wales.

name: Tomos Watkin
description: A Swansea brewery reviving old Welsh brewing names and recipes, Tomos Watkin produces a broad range from light blonde ales to darker traditional styles, sold widely across South Wales pubs and bottle shops.

beers.name: Blodwen
beers.description: A light, crisp blonde ale with a delicate hop character, one of the brewery's best known bottled beers.

beers.name: OSB
beers.description: A traditional Welsh best bitter with a full malt body and a gentle bitterness.

name: Boss Brewing
description: Founded by husband and wife team Sarah and Roy Allkin, Boss Brewing built its reputation on stouts and dark beers, taking the Champion Beer of Wales title for one of its stouts, alongside a wider modern core range.

beers.name: Boss Milk Stout
beers.description: A rich, smooth milk stout that won the brewery its Champion Beer of Wales title.

beers.name: Boss IPA
beers.description: A robust, citrus forward IPA sitting alongside the brewery's stout range.

name: Mumbles Brewery
description: Based near Swansea Bay, Mumbles Brewery makes a range of cask and bottled ales aimed squarely at the local pub trade, with an emphasis on approachable, sessionable strengths.

beers.name: Mumbles Original
beers.description: A light, sessionable bitter designed as an everyday cask pour.

name: Gower Brewery
description: Set on the Gower peninsula, this brewery runs a traditional cask range alongside a separate, more experimental line called Gower Brews. Tours through the brewery finish with tastings in its own tap room.

beers.name: Gower Gold
beers.description: A light, golden session ale and one of the brewery's most established cask beers.

beers.name: Gower Power
beers.description: A fuller bodied, stronger ale from the core cask range.

name: Harbwr Brewery
description: Housed in a converted warehouse above Tenby's harbour, Harbwr brews a modern, easy drinking range and runs a family friendly taproom that has become a regular stop for visitors to the town.

beers.name: Harbwr Pale
beers.description: A balanced, approachable pale ale built as the brewery's flagship taproom pour.

name: Bluestone Brewing Co
description: Brewed on a farm site in the Pembrokeshire hills, Bluestone leans on its rural setting for both its branding and its water source, producing a traditional range of cask and bottled ales.

beers.name: Bluestone Bitter
beers.description: A traditional, malt led bitter with a light hop finish.

name: Purple Moose Brewery
description: One of the most decorated breweries in Wales, Purple Moose runs its taproom from The Australia pub on Porthmadog High Street and also operates the Albion Ale House in Conwy in partnership with other North Wales breweries.

beers.name: Snowdonia Ale
beers.description: A light, gently hopped session bitter named for the mountains above the brewery.

beers.name: Dark Side of the Moose
beers.description: A dark, warming winter ale that has placed highly in national Champion Winter Beer awards.

beers.name: Elderflower Ale
beers.description: A pale ale brewed with elderflower for a delicate floral note, twice named Champion Speciality Beer of Wales.

name: Conwy Brewery
description: Brewing within sight of Conwy Castle, this brewery produces a broad cask and bottled range with a strong local following, distributed through pubs across North Wales.

beers.name: Castle Bitter
beers.description: A light, traditional bitter and one of the brewery's longest standing beers.

beers.name: Honey Fayre
beers.description: A golden ale brewed with honey for a smooth, rounded sweetness.

name: Wild Horse Brewing Co
description: A seaside brewery in Llandudno that has built a strong reputation for consistency, with a modern core range that regularly ranks among the highest rated in Wales on independent beer rating platforms.

beers.name: Wild Horse Pale
beers.description: A well balanced modern pale ale and the brewery's most widely available beer.

name: Bragdy Nant
description: A small brewery in the Conwy valley producing Welsh named ales, with a core range spanning porters, bitters and golden ales alongside seasonal specials.

beers.name: Mwnci Nel
beers.description: A dark, roasty porter and one of the brewery's core cask beers.

beers.name: Cwrw Coryn
beers.description: A traditional bitter with a light, easy drinking character.

beers.name: Chwaden Aur
beers.description: A pale golden ale with a soft, gentle hop presence.

name: Cwrw Llyn
description: A Welsh language brewery on the Llyn Peninsula producing a small, traditional range sold mainly through pubs and shops across Gwynedd.

beers.name: Seithenyn
beers.description: A light golden ale named after a figure from Welsh legend, brewed as the brewery's core session beer.

name: Bragdy Cybi
description: A nano brewery based in Holyhead on Anglesey, Bragdy Cybi punches well above its size, producing a rotating range of beers that consistently rank among the best reviewed in Wales.

beers.name: Cybi Pale
beers.description: A clean, approachable pale ale and one of the brewery's regular releases.

name: Wilderness
description: Founded by James Godman, Wilderness stands apart from most Welsh breweries by focusing on mixed fermentation and barrel aged beers rather than hop forward styles, using local fruit and a variety of house cultures.

beers.name: Fragile Self Confidence
beers.description: A rioja barrel aged pale ale with a complex, delicately sour character built through mixed fermentation.

name: Crafty Canary
description: One of the newest breweries in Wales, based in the Afan Valley near Port Talbot. Crafty Canary brews a compact house range alongside running a wider online shop of other Welsh and imported beers, ciders and spirits. Each of its own beers is named after a mountain bike trail through nearby Afan Forest Park.

beers.name: Skyline Lager
beers.description: A pale, crisp European-style lager and the strongest beer in the core range, named after the exposed ridge line stretch of the Blade trail. Clean and well balanced, built to be served properly cold.

beers.name: Penhydd Stout
beers.description: A roasty, dry stout named after one of the original red-graded mountain bike trails through Afan Forest Park. Dark chocolate and espresso notes lead, with a smooth, creamy body rather than anything sweet.

beers.name: Y Wal Golden Ale
beers.description: A straightforward, well balanced golden ale with a light honeyed malt character and a gentle floral hop finish. Named after the Welsh for "the wall", it sits in the middle of the range for both strength and character.

beers.name: Blue Scar
beers.description: A low strength session bitter with a soft, biscuity malt character and a restrained, earthy hop finish. Built for an easy pint over a long lunch rather than any big flavour statement.

beers.name: Blade IPA
beers.description: A citrus-forward IPA built around grapefruit and orange hop character, with a firm, dry, bitter finish. The most hop-driven beer in the range, named after the Blade trail through Afan Forest Park.

beers.name: Whites Ruby
beers.description: A deep, garnet-coloured ruby ale with a rich caramel and toffee malt character and a hint of dried red fruit. The fullest bodied beer in the range, built for colder months and heartier food.
